item.title: 【Live Audios (lossless)】FLAC - Rosalia + Juanes @ Hollywood Bowl 2018-09-05
item.description:
Hidden Content:
You must either reply or click 'Like' to see the hidden information contained here.

I left Juanes in for continuity purposes but probably mostly unlistenable.

Original notes when I posted Rosalia to Dime

"Opening for Juanes which was a recording disaster. (I told a friend like 2 hours in advance I had tix but looks like I can recoup on Stubhub, he said what? that sounds like an awesome show I will meet you there. He doesn't speak Spanish either) so I ran out the door and didn't have fresh batteries. Oops. Partway thru Juanes set I am downloading a android recording app on my phone but the results weren't very good."

Years after the fact I notice someone added this Rosalia setlist to the comments. I haven't added to info file yet. Decided to dig up Rosalia since I was thinking of seeing if I could score a cheap ticket for the Forum tonight but was never able to drag myself out. Maybe Wedensday? My original notes also said maybe I would go see her headline a club.
